FX-RIF-001.says: The setting as it starts: Softness 1, a Gaussian of sigma 1 down each column reaching 3 rows. Each row takes a little of the rows above and below it, so the darkening down each column is smoothed; the colours of neighbouring columns never mix; the top and bottom rows read themselves past the edge, so they do not fade; every covering is kept.

FX-RIF-002.says: Softness 0: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-RIF-003.says: Softness 2.5: reaching 8 rows, every column far smoother than FX-RIF-001.

FX-RIF-004.says: Softness 0.3: reaching one row, a slight softening.

FX-RIF-005.says: Softness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-RIF-001.

FX-RIF-006.says: FX-RIF-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-RIF-007.says: Softness 501, above 500. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIF-008.says: Softness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIF-009.says: Softness keyed to 600 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
